# awscc_ec2_client_vpn_authorization_rule (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::EC2::ClientVpnAuthorizationRule



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_vpn_endpoint_id` (String) The ID of the Client VPN endpoint.
- `target_network_cidr` (String) The IPv4 address range, in CIDR notation, of the network for which access is being authorized.

### Optional

- `access_group_id` (String) The ID of the group to grant access to, for example, the Active Directory group or identity provider (IdP) group. Required if `AuthorizeAllGroups` is `false` or not specified.
- `authorize_all_groups` (Boolean) Indicates whether to grant access to all clients. Specify `true` to grant all clients who successfully establish a VPN connection access to the network. Must be set to `true` if `AccessGroupId` is not specified.
- `description` (String) A brief description of the authorization rule.

### Read-Only

- `client_vpn_authorization_rule_id` (String) The ID of the Client VPN Authorization Rule.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_client_vpn_authorization_rule.example
  identity = {
    id = "id"
  }
}
```
